title: Console: capture and refund a Stripe payment
caption: Mirrors tools/e2e/specs/ota-admin/payments.e2e.ts (nightly, Stripe test mode). console.payments.capture needs payments:capture, refund needs payments:refund (owner, admin, finance).

steps.title: Make a payment wait
steps.body: Set the ticketing policy to Manual review; book on the storefront with a Stripe test card.

steps.title: Capture
steps.expect: `POST /v1/console/payments/{id}/capture` → `200`; payment `captured`, `payment_events` (source staff), `booking_events`, `staff_actions` `payment.capture`. Capturing a payment that is not an authorised Stripe payment → `409 CONFLICT` (payment_not_capturable); a stale If-Match → `412`.

steps.title: Partial refund
steps.body: Refund part of it with a reason.
steps.expect: `POST …/refunds` → `201` refund `pending`; `refund.submit` on `ota-payments` sends it; Stripe's webhook makes it `succeeded` and the payment `partially_refunded`. The customer sees `refund.requested`, then `refund.succeeded`.

steps.title: Airline-card payments
steps.body: Try to refund an airline-card payment.
steps.expect: Refused `422` (`refund_via_airline`): the airline refunds airline cards; no `refunds` row.

steps.title: Authorisation watch
steps.body: Leave an authorised payment uncaptured for more than 5 days (or inspect the job).
steps.expect: `payments.authorisation_watch` (06:15 UTC daily) alerts staff once per payment (`payment.authorisation_expiring` event).
